campus.en: Fictional demo university: one campus, no residences, its own colours
campus.zu: Inyuvesi yokubonisa eqanjiwe: ikhampasi eyodwa, azikho izindawo zokuhlala, imibala yayo

directions.en: From the gate, walk straight up and cross the main road. It is directly ahead.
directions.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde bese uwela umgwaqo omkhulu. Siphambi kwakho ngqo.

directions.en: From the gate, walk straight up to the main road and turn right. It is the last building on your left.
directions.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde uye emgwaqweni omkhulu bese ujikela kwesokudla. Yisakhiwo sokugcina ngakwesobunxele sakho.

directions.en: From the gate, take the first path on your left and walk to the end.
directions.zu: Usuka esangweni, thatha indlela yokuqala ngakwesobunxele uhambe uze ufike ekugcineni.

directions.en: From the gate, walk straight up. It is the first building on your left.
directions.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde. Yisakhiwo sokuqala ngakwesobunxele sakho.

directions.en: From the gate, walk straight up. It is the first building on your right.
directions.zu: Usuka esangweni, hamba uqonde. Yisakhiwo sokuqala ngakwesokudla sakho.

directions.en: The small building at the gate, on your right. Open 24 hours.
directions.zu: Isakhiwo esincane esangweni, ngakwesokudla sakho. Kuvulwe amahora angu-24.

reach.en: Walk in on any weekday. Bring your student card; nobody asks why you need it.
reach.zu: Ngena nganoma yiluphi usuku lwesonto. Letha ikhadi lakho lomfundi; akekho obuza ukuthi kungani uludinga.

reach.en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own. The Housing Desk keeps the list of accredited private rooms and checks leases with you.
reach.zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala. Ideski Lezindawo Zokuhlala ligcina uhlu lwamakamelo azimele agunyaziwe futhi lihlola izivumelwano nawe.

intro.en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own, so this list matters. These places are fictional, like the university.
intro.zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala, ngakho lolu hlu lubalulekile. Lezi zindawo ziqanjiwe, njengenyuvesi.

note.en: Not on the list? Don't pay anything. Ask the Housing Desk first.
note.zu: Ayikho ohlwini? Ungakhokhi lutho. Buza eDeskini Lezindawo Zokuhlala kuqala.

detail.en: Accredited private residence · 8 minutes' walk · NSFAS-accredited
detail.zu: Indawo ezimele egunyaziwe · imizuzu eyi-8 ngezinyawo · igunyazwe yi-NSFAS

detail.en: Accredited private residence · on the town shuttle route · NSFAS-accredited
detail.zu: Indawo ezimele egunyaziwe · isendleleni ye-shuttle yedolobha · igunyazwe yi-NSFAS

detail.en: Accredited private residence · 15 minutes' walk · self-catering
detail.zu: Indawo ezimele egunyaziwe · imizuzu eyi-15 ngezinyawo · uziphekela

intro.en: On a real campus this is the official list of result codes. Every university uses its own codes: these are examples, like Karoo Coast itself.
intro.zu: Ekhampasi yangempela lolu uhlu olusemthethweni lwamakhodi emiphumela. Inyuvesi ngayinye isebenzisa amakhodi ayo: lawa ayizibonelo, njengeKaroo Coast uqobo.

note.en: A supp usually needs a final mark just below the pass mark, often 40–49%. It is written within weeks, so check the date now.
note.zu: Isivivinyo esengeziwe ngokuvamile sidinga amamaki okugcina angaphansi nje kwamamaki okuphasa, imvamisa angu-40–49%. Sibhalwa emasontweni ambalwa, ngakho hlola usuku manje.

detail.en: You narrowly missed the pass mark and may write again. Confirm by the deadline.
detail.zu: Uphuthelwe kancane amamaki okuphasa futhi ungabhala futhi. Qinisekisa ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala.

detail.en: You were ill and handed in a medical certificate. You write on a later date.
detail.zu: Ubugula futhi wafaka isitifiketi sikadokotela. Uzobhala ngolunye usuku.

detail.en: You did not write and gave no accepted reason. See your faculty office at once.
detail.zu: Awubhalanga futhi awunikanga isizathu esamukelekayo. Bona ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho ngokushesha.

items.name: NAD · Not admitted to the exam

detail.en: Your semester mark was too low to write. Ask an advisor about repeating the module.
detail.zu: Amamaki akho esemesta abephansi kakhulu ukuthi ubhale. Buza umeluleki ngokuphinda isifundo.

detail.en: Your mark is not captured yet, or is held back for unpaid fees. Ask before you worry.
detail.zu: Amamaki akho awakafakwa, noma abanjiwe ngenxa yemali yokufunda engakhokhiwe. Buza ngaphambi kokukhathazeka.

intro.en: On a real campus this opens the university's own application site. Karoo Coast University is fictional, so these steps are an example.
intro.zu: Ekhampasi yangempela lokhu kuvula isayithi lezicelo lenyuvesi uqobo. I-Karoo Coast University iqanjiwe, ngakho lezi zinyathelo ziyisibonelo.

note.en: Apply only on the official site. Nobody can apply for you for a fee, and nobody can sell you a place.
note.zu: Faka isicelo kuphela kusayithi esemthethweni. Akekho ongakufakela isicelo ngenkokhelo, futhi akekho ongakuthengisela indawo.

detail.en: Each course lists the subjects and marks it needs. Check before you pay a fee.
detail.zu: Isifundo ngasinye sibala izifundo namamaki esiwadingayo. Hlola ngaphambi kokukhokha imali.

detail.en: Use your own email address and phone number, so the replies come to you.
detail.zu: Sebenzisa ikheli lakho le-imeyili nenombolo yakho yocingo, ukuze izimpendulo zize kuwe.

detail.en: A certified copy of your ID and your latest school results.
detail.zu: Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe kamazisi wakho nemiphumela yakho yakamuva yesikole.

detail.en: Use it to track your application and to answer every message before its deadline.
detail.zu: Yisebenzise ukulandelela isicelo sakho nokuphendula yonke imiyalezo ngaphambi kosuku lwayo lokuvala.

detail.en: Example dates: 1 April to 30 September. Residence applications close earlier.
detail.zu: Izinsuku eziyisibonelo: 1 Ephreli kuya ku-30 Septhemba. Izicelo zezindawo zokuhlala zivalwa ngaphambili.

outcome.en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own, so you start with the Housing Desk's accredited list. Good rooms go early.
outcome.zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala, ngakho uqala ngohlu olugunyaziwe lweDeski Lezindawo Zokuhlala. Amakamelo amahle aphela kusenesikhathi.

text.en: The campus shuttle to town stops at 6pm, and your tutorial ends at 6:30. Town is a forty-minute walk along the coast road.
text.zu: I-shuttle yasekhampasi eya edolobheni iyama ngo-6 kusihlwa, futhi ithuthorial yakho iphela ngo-6:30. Idolobha likude ngemizuzu engamashumi amane ngezinyawo emgwaqweni wasogwini.

outcome.en: Forty minutes in the dark, in the wind. You don't want to do that every week.
outcome.zu: Imizuzu engamashumi amane ebumnyameni, emoyeni. Awufuni ukwenza lokho masonto onke.

label.en: Arrange a lift in the group

outcome.en: Two classmates drive in from town. You share petrol money and never miss the tutorial again.
outcome.zu: Abafunda nawe ababili bashayela besuka edolobheni. Nabelana ngemali kaphethiloli futhi awuphinde uphuthelwe yithuthorial.

outcome.en: The Day Students' Room has a list for the 7pm shuttle, which only runs when students book it. You book every Tuesday.
outcome.zu: Igumbi Labafundi Abagibelayo linohlu lwe-shuttle yango-7, ehamba kuphela uma abafundi beyibhukha. Ubhukha njalo ngoLwesibili.

tip.en: Ask what runs on request. Late shuttles and security escorts often only run when someone books them.
tip.zu: Buza ukuthi yini ehamba ngokucela. Ama-shuttle asebusuku nokuphelezelwa kuvame ukuhamba kuphela uma othile ebhukha.
